$comment: The condition projection quoted before docs/FORCING-HONESTY.md existed, pinned to the git objects that reproduce it. `pins` is hand-authored and is the judgement in this file: `manifestCommit` is the commit the original campaign recorded as the tree it ran against, and `baselineCommit` is the earliest forcing baseline this repository carries, which is the later artifact the reconstruction reads the killer sets out of. `derived` is written by `scripts/condition-forcing-gate.py --sync-prior` and re-derived by `--verify-prior`, which reads both objects out of history and refuses anything but a match. The reconstruction restricts the baseline's killer sets to the vectors that existed at the pinned corpus, which is exact on the condition axis and says nothing about whether a dropped weakening was tolerated or ignored then. The original campaign's own per-site tables are not in this repository -- vectors/CHANGES.md says so under the revision that consumed them -- so this reconstruction, and not that campaign, is what a reader of this repository can check.

instrumentDelta.$why: The reconstruction and the released note disagreed by three weakenings over the same 590 sites and the same 179 vectors, and that residue was published here as unexplained. It is not. Three of the sites the reconstruction counts as killed sit on the branch a verifier takes when the consumer supplies NO substrate key policy, and only a run that makes a no-key pass can reach them: on the pinned-key pass the policy is present, so removing any of the three changes nothing. README.md and packaging/run_vectors.py both record that before the AEE_SUBSTRATE_KEYS channel existed the harness reported `tiers_without_key: None` for every run and the evaluator skips a tier column it was handed nothing for, so the run behind the note could not observe any of the three. `branch` is the predicate --verify-prior derives the set with, over the pinned baseline; `sites` is the set it must yield. Two handles on one fact: if a rename slips the predicate, the derived set stops matching this list and the gate refuses instead of quietly reporting a different number.
